tick_definition: One oriented Hamming-1 edge traversal in this illustrative walk; vertex samples and boundary support weights are separate types.
hinge_policy: Shared interface AB is retained as cell incidence. Its edge cancels from the outer boundary; the outer walk meets its endpoints. No extra edge is inserted for a unit RD support weight.
limitation: These cells and paths do not supply an AOD motif-admission, retained-return, fold or fusion certificate.
